description: About Etched Etched is building hardware for frontier intelligence. We co-design chips, racks, software, and manufacturing to deliver best-in-class throughput and latency across both prefill and decode workloads. Our first products are heavily focused on inference. Backed by hundreds of millions from top-tier investors and staffed by leading engineers, Etched is redefining the infrastructure layer for the fastest growing industry in history. Job Summary We are seeking talented Spring ‘27 and Summer ‘27 IA Research Engineer interns to build the agents that accelerate how Etched produces frontier tokens. You will embed with our kernels team and work alongside our founders on agentic harnesses, tools, and evals that let agents do long-running engineering work people actually rely on. This role is for builders who thrive on ambiguity, have real product sense, and want to own problems end to end. Key responsibilities Embed with our kernels team to find high-leverage bottlenecks and help turn them into tools engineers use every day. Build and deploy LLM agents wired into our engineering workflows via tool-calling and MCP. Help build execution environments where agents can verify their own work, with sandboxed access to simulators, compilers, profilers, and real hardware. Ship internal products end to end, including the interfaces, data pipelines, and infrastructure behind them. Design evals and track adoption to measure which tools are working and which aren’t. Support special projects with the founders across the company. You may be a good fit if you have Progress towards a Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD degree in computer science, computer engineering, or a related field Strong software engineering fundamentals and a record of shipping projects other people use Built agents for multi-step tasks beyond calling an API: tool design, context management, evals, and failure analysis Heavy use of coding agents, including reading their transcripts and changing the system when an agent is confidently wrong High agency in unfamiliar domains, product sense, and extreme attention to detail Strong candidates may have some experience with Chip development, GPU kernels, hardware, or manufacturing Infrastructure, data engineering, or DevOps Fine-tuning, RAG over technical data, or multi-agent orchestration Hackathons, startups, or side projects with real users We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every qualification. Program details 12-week paid internship Daily lunch and dinner in our office Based at our office in San Jose, CA Direct mentorship from industry leaders and world-class engineers Opportunity to work on one of the most important problems of our time For any questions, contact internships@etched.com. How we’re different Etched believes in the Bitter Lesson. We are the first inference-focused frontier AI system. Our addressable market is the entirety of inference, unlike many of our competitors. We are a fully in-person team in San Jose (Santana Row), and greatly value engineering skills. We do not have boundaries between engineering and research, and we expect all of our technical staff to contribute to both and work across disciplines as needed.

We apply aerospace engineering and quality standards across our products, delivering high performance, reliability, and efficiency for the most demanding operating environments. Astro Mechanica is backed by leading venture and strategic investors, including Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Giant Step Capital, United Airlines Ventures, and Voyager Ventures. WHO WE ARE: We’re a team of passionate engineers dedicated to advancing aerospace. We’re generalists with specialist depth, united by a flat structure and a shared obsession with building things that work well. We move fast, stay pragmatic, and let engineering excellence speak louder than hierarchy. WHO YOU ARE: Astro Mechanica is seeking an intern to join our Test Team for the summer of 2027 (program begins on June 7, 2027 for semester schools and June 27, 2027 for quarter schools). The ideal candidate is excited to help design, fabricate, operate, and improve the test infrastructure supporting our jet engine and subsystems. As an intern, you’ll be embedded with the test team in Antioch or Alameda, working on real test stands and hardware alongside full-time engineers. Your work will help keep test operations running smoothly while expanding and improving our test capabilities. In this role, your mission will be to help create and operate test infrastructure for hardware research and development, with mentorship from senior engineers along the way. You’ll see firsthand how new designs are rigorously tested to meet quality and performance targets before they’re integrated into the aircraft. You embody the test-like-you-fly philosophy. WHAT YOU’LL DO: Help design test stands, fixtures, and supporting hardware to enable new test capabilities Support development of test plans, instrumentation schemes, and data collection methods that capture high-quality, decision-driving data Create and update documentation, including P&IDs, electrical schematics, and test procedures, while working with stakeholders to make sure stand requirements are met Assist with fabrication, assembly, and activation of test stands and fixtures Support test operations, including setup, instrumentation, execution, and teardown Analyze test data and compare results with analytical models or simulations Help troubleshoot test facility problems and find ways to improve test throughput and reliability Own a scoped project through the summer and present your results to the team at the end of the internship WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR: Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline Club, project, research, or internship hands-on experience with fluidic, mechanical, or electrical systems Exposure to instrumentation and test hardware (pressure transducers, thermocouples, load cells, relays, solenoids, pneumatics) Familiarity with CAD and the ability to design simple test hardware, fixtures, or modifications Experience with Python, MATLAB, or similar tools for data analysis Exposure to data acquisition systems (e.g., LabVIEW, NI hardware) is a plus Hands-on fabrication skills (machining, wiring, soldering, plumbing) are a plus Respect for safety when working around pressurized systems, flammables, and high voltage Attentive to detail and committed to a high level of quality in all work Flexibility to work in a fast-paced environment Available for a full-time, in-person internship in San Francisco during Summer 2027 (approximately 10–12 weeks) PERKS & BENEFITS: Competitive hourly pay Hands-on mentorship from experienced engineers Company-funded perks, including team lunches, game nights, and other activities ADDITIONAL INFORMATION: At Astro Mechanica, we highly value in-office work to foster collaboration and strengthen our company culture. description: About us Every large organisation runs on a web of legal entities, and the data behind them is scattered across in-house teams, law firms and accountants in PDFs, spreadsheets and slide decks. Jigsaw brings it into one place. We started by giving lawyers and accountants a faster way to model client structures, and became the category leader doing it. Today 240+ organisations use Jigsaw, including all 10 of the world’s top 10 accountancy firms. Now we’re building Entity Lifecycle Management: one live record for every entity, from formation to dissolution. Founded by former lawyer and repeat founder Stephen Scanlan, and backed by Exor Ventures. Why join us : You’ll help define a new software category with the backing of a loyal, global customer base. We hire people with high ownership and a bias for action, then trust them to do their best work. The opportunity We're looking for three Trainees to join Jigsaw in January 2027 on a 12-month rotational programme. It's an entry-level, generalist scheme: you'll work across the three core functions of Jigsaw, Client, Build and Ops, seeing how most of the business runs, and working out where your strengths really lie. You don't need a degree, and you don't need to have done this kind of work before. We don’t care about a polished CV, we want someone with the right attitude, energy, and a curiosity to try out a range of different roles. At the end of the year there's the potential for a permanent role. Is this for you? This programme is for people who don't yet know exactly what they want to do next, and see that as a reason to explore rather than a problem to fix. You might be leaving school, college or university, or returning to work after a career change and happy to start at square one. It's not for you if you already know the career you're chasing. If you want to become a software engineer, a lawyer or a specialist in one field, a dedicated graduate or apprenticeship scheme will serve you better. Here you'll move teams every few months, switch between very different kinds of work, and won't be specialising in any one craft. How the year works You'll report to our COO, who has helped build several successful startups. Each rotation gives you real work to own, with people in the team to learn from along the way. Onboarding and Product Success (first six weeks) You'll start together as a cohort. You'll spend time with our Product Marketing team learning about the product and who our clients are, then join Product Success. There you'll see the end-to-end cycle of what we build, how clients use it and how it gets implemented, and you'll start working with clients yourself. From there, each of you moves into a different area and you rotate through the rest of the year. Client You'll learn how we identify what a client needs and how we pitch Jigsaw. In prospecting, you'll get to know our ideal customer profiles, reach out to and build relationships with potential clients, and report on sales results. In Customer Success, you'll support existing clients, shadow client calls, organise training sessions on behalf of a Customer Success Manager, help shape retention strategies and find ways the team can work more efficiently with AI. You may also help with marketing and social content. Build You’ll get involved in the day-to-day operations of how a technology company plans and manages their work. You'll see how a product gets built in an AI-native company, and how that changes the way the work is done. You'll follow the journey from an idea to the roadmap to a shipped feature. Ops You'll learn what it takes to scale a business of any kind. In RevOps, you'll help organise the sales tools we use, such as HubSpot and Jiminny, shape the playbook the sales team runs on, and build the content and emails we use for outreach. Across Ops, you'll develop strategic thinking, project management and commercial awareness, and may take on AI project work. Few early-career roles let you see how a growing software company wins clients, builds product and scales its operations, all in one year Real work from the start. Each rotation comes with work you own and deliver, not just tasks to shadow, and you'll work directly with clients at some of the world's leading law firms and financial institutions Support around you. You'll join as a cohort of three, report to our COO and have people in each team to learn from, with regular check-ins and reviews throughout each rotation Skills that travel. You'll build communication, problem-solving, project management and commercial skills, and learn how an AI-native company works day to day Clarity on what's next. By the end of the year you'll know where your strengths lie, with the potential to move into a permanent role at Jigsaw What to expect A video screening call: An intro call with a member of the people team to learn more about you, and what you’re looking to get out of this programme A video hiring manager call: Meet with the COO who will want to understand more about your ways of working and how you tackle challenges An on-site interview day: If selected, you’ll join us in our London office on November 27th. We help businesses become AI-native through training, hiring, and infrastructure. Since our founding in 2021, we've helped tens of thousands of people reach their most ambitious goals and raised $19M from world-class investors. Ambition is sacred to us, and we've built a product that takes that seriously. We're looking for sharp, AI-native builders to join us as AI Education Interns and help run one of the most ambitious AI training programs in the market. This isn't a shadow-and-learn internship. You'll facilitate live sessions for working professionals, keep curriculum current as AI tools evolve, and help build the systems that power the whole program. If you are an AI enthusiast, can execute without hand-holding, and are able to explain hard concepts simply, we want to talk with you. What you'll be doing : Supporting live AI Builder Program sessions as an instructor's assistant for cohorts of working professionals QA-ing sessions before they go live and improving curriculum between cohorts as AI tools change Supporting students in Slack, during office hours, and through live troubleshooting Building and maintaining AI automations and systems that power program delivery Helping design new sessions and levels as we expand to Levels 3-5 and bring on B2B custom cohorts Your qualifications: Currently enrolled in or recently graduated from a college program AI-native: you've built automations, workflows, or tools, not just used AI assistants Can explain complex technical concepts clearly to a room of non-technical professionals Available to work 20-30 hours per week during school semester, with at least 2 days in-person in Lehi, UT office Your identity: High-agency operator who doesn't wait to be told what to do AI-native builder who actively creates automations and uses AI to move faster and do more Clear communicator who can make hard things click for people who didn't grow up in tech Fast mover who's comfortable with ambiguity and iterates fast Scrappy and gritty, not afraid of the unglamorous work required to actually win Energetic self-starter whose instinct is to figure it out, not ask for permission Patient and collaborative problem-solver with customers learning new technology What this role unlocks: Strong AI Education Interns become top candidates for full-time roles on Leland AI Services, where companies hire us to come in and implement AI for their teams. description: About Mariana Minerals Mariana Minerals is a software-first, vertically integrated minerals company on a mission to supply the critical minerals powering modern energy, AI, and defense technologies. We’re reimagining the minerals supply chain by combining deep industry expertise with advanced software, automation, and data-driven decision-making. We’re building modern mining and processing operations, and we’re looking for people who want to keep them running and grow with us. This is open to students who have finished a technical program or are about to, and to people with industrial or mechanical experience who are new to mining. Maintenance techs are the backbone of any mine site. It’s hands-on work with real equipment, new problems to solve every day, and skills that stay in demand across industries. Join early and you’ll learn from experienced techs, see how a modern operation comes together, and build a career with a company that’s just getting started. Program details are still coming together, but we’re connecting early with people who want to help build this team. What You Could Learn Mechanical maintenance: pumps, conveyors, crushers, hydraulics, and heavy equipment Electrical maintenance: motors, controls, VFDs, and instrumentation Preventive maintenance and real-time troubleshooting across the mine and processing plant Mine site safety, including MSHA training, lockout/tagout, arc flash (NFPA 70E), rigging, confined space, and working at heights Who Should Apply Students in electrical, mechanical, or industrial maintenance programs, and recent trade school or technical program grads Welders, fabricators, heavy equipment operators, drillers, or facilities techs with a stable work history who want to build maintenance skills Experienced mechanics, electricians, or military-trained techs looking to move into mining Comfortable with hand and power tools (experience helps but isn’t required for students) What Makes You a Fit You never cut corners to save time. You follow procedures, speak up when something doesn’t look right, and look out for the people around you. You see a job through, own your mistakes, and keep pushing until the problem is actually fixed, even when the work is dirty or tough, or the weather isn’t cooperating. You’re curious about how things work and always looking for a simpler, better way to do the job. You want to understand the systems, not just follow the steps. You ask questions, share what you learn, and jump in wherever your crew needs you. You know the best work gets done together. Working Environment & Physical Requirements This is a mine site, and safety comes first every day. Outdoor and industrial work with dust, loud noise, and weather from summer heat to winter cold Required PPE: hard hat, steel-toe boots, safety glasses, high-vis clothing, and hearing protection, plus respirators and fall protection when needed Following site safety rules at all times Lifting up to 50 lbs, climbing, working at heights, and entering confined spaces Our culture is built on four principles: Everyone Gets Home Safe. We never put speed or cost ahead of people. Extreme Ownership. We take full responsibility for outcomes, relentlessly driving toward solutions. Engineer Out Requirements, then Automate. We simplify, optimize, and then automate for scale. Share Your Legos. We collaborate openly, share knowledge, and empower each other to build bigger, better solutions. Join us as we build the future of responsible mineral sourcing and supply!

description: About Mercor Mercor’s mission is to organize human intelligence for the AI economy. We build the infrastructure that enables frontier AI labs and enterprises to train, evaluate, and improve AI on real-world professional work. More than five million experts have joined our network, and we pay out over $5 million daily for their knowledge and expertise. We built our training and evaluation infrastructure alongside the world’s leading AI labs. Now, we’re bringing those capabilities to enterprises across industries, enabling them to train, evaluate, and improve AI using their own expertise and standards. Our APEX benchmarks measure how AI performs on economically valuable work, while our enterprise evaluations and post-training capabilities turn those insights into measurable improvements across real-world workflows. Our work sits at the intersection of frontier AI, human expertise, and real-world application. intern-to-full-time conversion. description: Who We Are Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together . We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. This internship will take place from May 24 - August 13 or June 14 - Sept 3 (based on your summer schedule) and you will need to be able to work out of our NY office during this time. Please only apply to the internship role that best fits your interest / experience. Multiple applications may result in delayed review of your application. About the Role Help build the iOS platform that lets engineers ship confidently. As Notion’s mobile team grows, we’re turning our first generation of mobile foundations into a durable platform: clearer architecture, easier testing, dependable observability, and faster CI/CD. As an intern, you’ll own a focused project on that platform over the summer, working alongside engineers on our mobile platform, mobile AI, and core product teams. You’ll see firsthand what slows mobile engineers down and ship something that makes their work faster. What You’ll Achieve Ship a real project to production: Working with your mentor, you’ll scope an iOS project from problem definition to a shipped result by the end of the summer. Make the iOS platform friendlier to engineers and agents: Help build and improve ways to build, run, test, and screenshot the app, so engineers and AI agents can iterate quickly without lowering the quality bar. Learn how a production iOS platform works: Get exposure to shared frameworks, build systems, release quality, and our shared Rust layer. Qualifications: Pursuing a bachelor's or master’s degree in computer science, engineering, or another related field. Must graduate before Summer 2028. This internship will take place from May 24 - August 13 or June 14 - September 3 (based on your summer schedule) and you will need to be able to work out of our NY office during this time. Previous internship experience. Working towards proficiency of one or more programming languages such as Swift, Typescript, and React. You find large challenges exciting and enjoy discovering problems as much as solving them. You are able to problem-solve and adapt to changing priorities in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. Skills You’ll Need To Bring: Thoughtful problem-solving: For you, problem-solving starts with a clear and accurate understanding of the context. You can decompose tricky problems and work towards a clean solution, by yourself or with teammates. You're comfortable asking for help when you get stuck. Put users first: You think critically about the implications of what you're building, and how it shapes real people's lives. You understand that reach comes with responsibility for our impact—good and bad. Not ideological about technology: To you, technologies and programming languages are about tradeoffs. You may be opinionated, but you're not ideological and can learn new technologies as you go. Empathetic communication: You communicate nuanced ideas clearly, whether you're explaining technical decisions in writing or brainstorming in real time. In disagreements, you engage thoughtfully with other perspectives and compromise when needed. Team player: For you, work isn't a solo endeavor. You enjoy collaborating cross-functionally to accomplish shared goals, and you care about learning, growing, and helping others to do the same. AI enthusiast: You have built or prototyped features with AI technologies (LLMs, Embeddings, ML) and are interested in learning more. Nice to Haves: You have expertise with specific technologies that are part of our stack, including Typescript, React, and Python. You've heard of computing pioneers like Ada Lovelace, Douglas Engelbart, Alan Kay, and others—and understand why we're big fans of their work. You have interests outside of technology, such as in art, history, or social sciences. Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. For roles based in New York City, the estimated hourly range for this role is $57/hr for Bachelors and $61/hr for Master’s. description: About Taara: Born at X, Google's Moonshot Factory, Taara is on a mission to connect billions of people lacking abundant and affordable internet today by pioneering the way we use light to deliver faster, cheaper, more reliable connectivity. We are bringing groundbreaking wireless optical communication and photonics chip technologies to the world to bridge the digital divide. Joining Taara allows you to work as part of a multidisciplinary team of experts in optics, software, and hardware, all collaborating to solve the hardest connectivity challenges on a global scale. If you want to tackle problems that matter and build tools with real-world impact, we would love to meet you. About the Role: As an Optical PLL Research Intern , you will lay the groundwork for an integrated optical phase-locked loop (OPLL) that locks an external laser for coherent reception in next-generation wireless optical links. This is a long-term project spanning lab and simulation, ideally a year or more. It could also anchor a thesis or a longer-term collaboration. What such a loop can achieve is bounded by real components. You will evaluate lasers, modulators, and analog electronics, build benchtop experiments around them, and work toward a stable closed loop. In parallel, you will extend our simulation and use the two to check each other. There is genuine room to shape the direction. Survey what is available, design your own experiments, and follow the evidence to the strongest design. How you will make 10X Impact: Component Evaluation: Screen commercial lasers, modulators, and photodetectors. Measure what vendors do not publish. Loop Design: Design the loops that track carrier phase and frequency, and validate them against control theory. Chip Requirements: Define what the integrated OPLL needs from its laser, electronics, and loop. Physical-Layer Simulation: Extend our model of the link and reconcile it with measurement. What you should have: Currently pursuing a Master's or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Applied Physics, Optics, Communications, or a related field. A strong background in analog and RF electronics and circuit design , including noise, bandwidth, and delay analysis. Hands-on lab experience with lasers, modulators, photodetectors , and high-speed test equipment. Control theory applied on hardware: closing feedback loops and diagnosing oscillation, drift, or loss of lock. Working knowledge of digital communications and signal processing . Availability of at least 6 months, ideally 12 or more, and three days per week in the Sunnyvale office. It'd be great if you also had one or more of these: Laser Locking: Frequency stabilization, tunable sources, phase-locked loops, carrier recovery, or coherent detection. Photodetection & Front-End Electronics: Photoreceiver, TIA, or high-speed circuit design. Numerical Methods: Scientific Python (NumPy, SciPy, JAX), phase-noise modeling, or cycle-slip statistics. Domain Knowledge: Optical or RF communications, photonics, or fading channels. What we offer: Competitive salary: $7,000–$10,000/month depending on degree. Flexible duration to fit your academic schedule. Direct mentorship from industry-leading engineers in a "moonshot" environment. Opportunity to work on technology that has the potential to change how billions of people access the internet.

The ACLU seeks a Legal Intern for the Policy & Government Affairs team within the National Political Advocacy Department of the ACLU’s National office in Washington D.C. This internship is Hybrid.

Qualifying applicants must currently be matriculated Legal students or an equivalent combination of education and/or experience and must be based in the U.S. for the entire duration of the internship.

The Team:

The National Political Advocacy Department (NPAD) works to strengthen the efforts of the ACLU at the federal, state, and local levels of government. The department harnesses the political power that comes from having more than eight million members and supporters, as well as affiliates in every state. By organizing grassroots lobbying and issue campaigns using modern tactics, the ACLU seeks to continue to achieve change as profound in the legislative, administrative and electoral arenas as it accomplishes through the courts.  

The Democracy and Technology Policy & Government Affairs team is made up of eight members, including seven attorneys, who work with Congress, state legislatures, regulatory agencies and others to strengthen and protect rights to voting, free speech, and privacy; to advance racial justice; and to ensure that emerging technologies (in artificial intelligence, algorithmic decision-making, and surveillance) are not used to deny rights or discriminate.

What You’ll Do:

The intern will work on legal and policy research and writing-related projects centered on racial justice, and technology policy. They will assist members of our team with researching and analyzing legislation, elected officials, coalition partners, and relevant developments in the political and advocacy landscapes on the state and federal levels. They will help prepare advocacy and public education materials, correspondence, and reports as needed. They will also support our team's efforts to do congressional outreach through the form of briefings, meetings on Capitol Hill, and letters.

description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

 

The community you will join:

Airbnb is seeking a Market Associate intern to join the Experiences team in Paris for a 6-month internship. 

The EMEA Experiences team at Airbnb focuses on building, supporting, and scaling the supply of world-class activities offered by local hosts across the region. The team works at the intersection of sales, product, operations, and community, helping hosts create unique moments of connection for guests. Our mission is to raise the quality and reliability of Experiences while supporting sustainable growth in priority markets. We partner closely with local teams, product specialists, and central operations to strengthen host success and ensure the best on-platform experience for guests.

We are looking for a proactive and curious student in Paris, who is excited to learn about the Experiences business and the world of host operations. The ideal candidate is detail oriented, motivated by supporting partners, and comfortable switching between hosts, guests, internal teams and tools in the same day. A strong sense of ownership, a collaborative mindset, comfort with data, and a willingness to learn quickly will help you thrive in this role.

 

The difference you will make:

You will support our Senior Market Manager in Paris on the day to day management of the Paris portfolio. This internship will give you exposure to all aspects of account management, from host operations and escalation management to performance tracking, content quality and supply growth. During your internship, you’ll have the opportunity to work on the following:

Supporting the Senior Market Manager on top accounts

  • Preparing recurring reports on bookings, cancellations and account level performance, and inputs for the weekly supply call.
  • Supporting day to day operations, such as host requests, listing updates, review removal requests and guest cases, and organising host calls, workshops and events.
  • Supporting escalations with product, engineering and API partners, from gathering booking references and logs to following up until issues are resolved.

Owning your own projects

  • Managing the long tail of Paris hosts: answering their requests, improving listing quality and performance, and flagging hosts at risk of churn.
  • Reviewing Experience pages for accuracy and completeness, sourcing new supply, and identifying supply gaps from guest feedback and market research.

 

The intern experience:

As an intern, you’ll be integrated into a team where you’ll contribute to challenging projects. Your manager, team, and our incredible employee community will strive to be superhosts to you during your internship. We provide the support, mentorship, fun, and real world experience needed to accelerate your learning and make a real impact on our product, as Airbnb revolutionizes connection, belonging, and travel. You can expect to:

  • Collaborate with multiple team members to achieve project milestones
  • Communicate with stakeholders across different teams to provide project updates
  • Seek and provide feedback throughout the internship
  • Actively participate in and contribute to the Experience and broader Airbnb community

 

Your expertise:

  • Current students or recent graduates (completed degree within the last 12 months) from leading business or engineering schools, or related programs in France, with a strong academic foundation and interest in applying coursework to real-world business challenges.
  • Fluent in French and English, with the ability to communicate clearly and professionally in both languages across written, verbal, and presentation settings.
  • Highly organized and detail-oriented, able to manage several live cases at once, follow up until resolution, and maintain accuracy in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
  • Outstanding communication skills, including the ability to synthesize information, collaborate cross-functionally, and convey ideas clearly to a range of stakeholders.
  • Strong interest in hospitality, tourism, or community-oriented environments, with enthusiasm for creating thoughtful, human-centered experiences.
  • Curious about data and performance metrics, with an interest in using insights and quantitative analysis to evaluate experiences, track performance, and inform decision-making. Comfort with troubleshooting tools and reading technical logs is a plus.
  • Work authorization for the country in which this role is based

 

Your location:

Due to the nature of this position, the successful applicant will need to be based in Paris, France to be able to conduct their work. Interns can expect to spend half of their time at the office and half working remotely with exact dates as agreed upon by the hiring manager. Additional in-person attendance for team meetings or offsites may be required as needed. Please note we are unable to provide relocation or visa sponsorship for this position.

  •   Work with the team’s data scientists to turn those findings into improvements in the next version of the forecast
  •   Communicate findings clearly to partners across Finance and the business, in written readouts and recurring reviews

description:
Software Development Interns - Waterloo University

Remote - Winter Session

About Brave

Brave is on a mission to protect the human right to privacy online. We’ve built a free web browser that blocks creepy ads and trackers by default, a private search engine with a truly independent index, private AI assistant, latest privacy and security features, and a private ad network (opt-in!) that directly rewards you for your attention. Already over 120 million people regularly use Brave for a faster, more private web. Millions more switch every month.

The internet is a sea of ads, hackers, and echo chambers. Big Tech makes huge profits off our data, and tells us what’s true and what’s not. Brave is fighting back. Join us!

Brave is hiring 2 Software Engineer interns this fall from Waterloo University to assist adding AI, security and privacy features to our products. 

Software Developer Co-op - Internship Role One

Contribute to the design, development, and maintenance of data-intensive systems and AI-powered services. 

Key responsibilities include:

  • Build and maintain ETL pipelines for ingesting, transforming, and loading structured and unstructured data across internal systems
  • Develop backend services and tooling in Python and TypeScript to support data processing workflows and API integrations
  • Integrate and optimize LLM inference pipelines, including prompt engineering, model serving, and evaluation of large language model outputs
  • Deploy and manage containerized workloads on Kubernetes, including writing manifests, configuring autoscaling, and troubleshooting cluster issues
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve data quality, pipeline reliability, and system observability

Software Developer (Privacy) Co-op - Internship Role 2

Contribute to the design, development, and shipping of privacy and security features in the Brave browser (based on Chromium).

Key responsibilities include:

  • Prototype, implement, and ship privacy-enhancing features end-to-end in C++ or Rust for the Brave browser
  • Build browser-native privacy protections privacy-enhancing permissions and anti-fingerprinting defenses
  • Navigate and contribute to an extremely large, complex codebase, applying knowledge of the Web security model and Chromium's architecture
  • Work with Web technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) to develop and validate browser features
  • Collaborate async with a geographically-distributed, open source team using Git and GitHub

Working at Brave - What we offer

  • Ability to work remotely at an exciting and well-funded international startup headquartered in San Francisco
  • Cutting-edge technology, allowing you to work with state-of-the-art tools and software solutions
  • Competitive compensation of $6000.00 per month for 4 months.
  • Great international exposure and team atmosphere

If you are currently a student at Waterloo University, we would love to hear from you.  We offer flexible schedules to accommodate your studies.

Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Engineering at Brex

Engineering at Brex is about building systems that scale with speed and intention. Our teams span Software, Data, Security, and IT, and operate with high autonomy and deep collaboration. We tackle hard technical problems, own our outcomes, and push for excellence at every level — from architecture to deployment. It’s an environment where engineering is a craft, and builders become leaders.

What you’ll do

We’re looking for folks with an interest in building products, services, and infrastructure, comfortable in dealing with lots of moving pieces. In partnership with your mentor and team, you’ll be building solutions that will drive direct business impact and shape our long-term technical vision with a high-quality bar. You'll have the opportunity to learn and push the frontier of providing the best financial software experience to help companies grow. You’ll be encouraged to be metric and data-driven and to think creatively to help Brex scale and prepare for the new markets we are about to enter.

Where you’ll work

This internship is remote. If you’re converted to full-time at the end of the program, the role becomes hybrid out of our São Paulo office — so please only apply if you’re based in SP or open to relocating if converted.

Requirements

  • Graduating from a BA/BS program in 2027 - Computer Science or Computer Engineering or Software Engineering
  • Availability to participate in the program from February to December 2027
  • Strong knowledge of CS fundamentals
  • Strong communication, interpersonal skills, and eagerness to learn from others
  • Are excited about working in a high-paced environment with other high quality engineers
  • Familiarity with software engineering development cycles
  • Experience working with backend programming languages (i.e. Java, Kotlin, Python)
  • Experience working with SQL or NoSQL databases
  • Ability to hold yourself and the team to high standards
  • Advanced English communication skills

Bonus points

  • Experience collaborating with experts in product, design, and operations
  • Familiarity with functional programming languages 
  • Strong writing skills
  • Proactive approach
  • Experience with corporate financial systems or concepts
  • Experience with cloud computing systems & services

Location

  • The internship is remote, but conversion to full-time is hybrid out of our São Paulo office. Please only apply if you are based in São Paulo (state) or willing to relocate upon conversion.

The Role

As a Technical Consulting Intern at Capco, you’ll join our Financial Services consulting teams working with leading banks, payments providers, and wealth management firms. This internship is designed for students from a range of technical disciplines who enjoy problem-solving, exploring technology, and understanding how systems, data, and business processes work together.

You’ll gain hands-on experience supporting client engagements, collaborating with experienced consultants, and contributing to technology-driven initiatives. Whether your interests lie in software development, data analytics, systems design, or emerging technologies, you’ll have opportunities to apply your knowledge while developing practical consulting skills.

What You’ll Do

  • Support technology and digital transformation projects across banking, payments, capital markets, and wealth management.
  • Assist with analyzing technical systems, business processes, data flows, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Contribute to technical research, data analysis, dashboards, prototypes, or other technology-related deliverables.
  • Collaborate with project teams to gather requirements, document findings, and support the design of practical solutions.
  • Prepare clear presentations, documentation, and research materials to communicate technical findings and recommendations.

What We’re Looking For

  • Currently pursuing a degree or diploma in technical disciplines such as Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Data Analytics, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • An interest in technology, analytical thinking, and solving practical problems.
  • Ability to understand technical concepts and communicate ideas clearly to different audiences.
  • Exposure through coursework, personal projects, or other experiences to programming, data analysis, technical tools, or systems and processes.
  • A collaborative approach, willingness to learn, and ability to contribute effectively in a team environment.

Bonus Points For

  • Interest in financial services, fintech, consulting, or digital transformation.
  • Familiarity with programming languages or technical tools such as Python, SQL, Java, Excel, or data visualization platforms.
  • Experience/familiarity  with LLMs or AI tools such as GPT, Codex, Gemini, or Copilot.
  • Experience with academic projects, internships, hackathons, or collaborative technical assignments.
  • Curiosity about emerging technologies, cloud platforms, automation, or modern software and data solutions.
  • Interest in exploring new technologies and applying technical knowledge to business challenges.

Why Join Capco

  • Gain hands-on experience contributing to real consulting engagements with leading financial institutions.
  • Learn from experienced consultants and develop practical technical, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Explore different areas of technology consulting, including software, data, systems, and digital transformation.
  • Work in a collaborative, non-hierarchical consulting culture where your ideas and contributions are valued.
  • Build professional connections and develop skills that support future internship and full-time career opportunities.

Compensation

The salary range for this position is CAD $23–$25 per hour.

Why This Role Is Open

We are currently hiring for this role due to an existing or newly created vacancy within our organization. This position is open as part of our ongoing business needs, and we are actively reviewing applications to fill this role with a qualified candidate who can make an immediate impact.

The posting expires on November 13, 2026.

Inclusion at Capco

We’re committed to making our recruitment process accessible and straightforward for everyone. If you need any adjustments at any stage, just let us know – we’ll be happy to help. We value each person’s unique perspective and contribution. At Capco, we believe that being yourself is your greatest strength. Our #BeYourselfAtWork culture encourages individuality and collaboration – a mindset that shapes how we work with clients and each other every day.

Use of Artificial Intelligence in Talent Acquisition

At Capco, we use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support and enhance several parts of talent acquisition. AI is used as a support tool only. All hiring decisions are made by talent acquisition and hiring teams.

About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available locations: 

  • Austin, TX
  • San Francisco, CA

Available Term

  • Winter (January - April 2027) 

About the Role

Cloudflare's HR/AI Transformation team makes HR work simpler and more effective. We redesign how work gets done, build internal tools (including AI tools), and run learning programs that help people adopt new ways of working. 

As our intern working on programs and processes, you'll help run those learning programs, keep our projects on track, and turn people's challenges into clear problem statements and process maps. You'll work directly with the head of AI Transformation & People Strategy, alongside HR leaders, process owners and engineers. This internship starts in January 2027 and is designed for a current student who is highly organized, writes clearly and is curious about how AI can improve the way people work.

Responsibilities

  • Plan and run our learning programs, including scheduling sessions, coordinating speakers and materials, and sending announcements and follow-ups.
  • Maintain a single, up-to-date view of all team projects, and follow up with project owners to keep work moving.
  • Write short, clear status updates for team leaders and stakeholders.
  • Meet with people across the HR function to understand their challenges, and summarize what you learn in clear problem statements.
  • Document how key processes work today, and help prepare workshops to redesign them.
  • Own one project from start to finish, with a named sponsor and a clean handoff at the end of your internship.

Requirements

  • Currently enrolled in a program studying business or similar.
  • Experience planning and managing projects or programs.
  • Strong written communication, including the ability to turn a messy conversation into a clear, simple summary.
  • Strong organization and follow-through across many people, details and deadlines.
  • Confidence working with senior leaders and reaching out to people you haven't met.
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools in your work or studies.
  • Ability to commit to a full-time (40 hours/week Monday - Friday) for a minimum 12 week internship.
  • In office 3-5 days a week.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Background in consulting, operations, HR or process improvement.
  • Experience with process mapping, user research or workshop facilitation.
  • Familiarity with capacity planning and project tracking tools such as Jira, Asana or Smartsheet.

Compensation
Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.

For San Francisco Bay Area based hires: Estimated hourly rate of $27.00/hr.

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

Position Overview

At Eulerity, we are building the future of AI-driven marketing automation — and behind every great hire is a great recruiting process. We are looking for a highly organized, tech-curious intern to support our technical recruiting lifecycle. You will learn to identify engineering talent, understand our tech stack, and manage the specialized candidate journey for software engineers.

This is not a passive, administrative internship. You will work directly under our Recruiter to keep our hiring engine running at full speed — coordinating interviews, tracking candidate progress, gathering and synthesizing interviewer feedback, and learning how to identify and source top talent. You will get an unfiltered look at how a high-growth startup builds its team, and you will be a meaningful part of making it happen.

What You Will Do

  • Interview Coordination & Candidate Experience
    • Own the Schedule: Coordinate interview logistics across multiple roles and hiring teams, ensuring candidates and interviewers are aligned, prepared, and on time.
  • Manage the Candidate Journey: Serve as a point of contact for candidates throughout the process, ensuring every touchpoint is timely, professional, and reflects Eulerity's brand.
    • Support the scheduling of technical screenings and pair-programming interviews, ensuring we have the right interviewer pairings for our tech stack.
  • Feedback Collection & Reporting
    • Help aggregate technical assessment scores and interviewer feedback to ensure we are assessing both soft skills and coding competency consistently.
  • Talent Sourcing (Learning Track)
    • Go beyond LinkedIn. Learn to use GitHub, Stack Overflow, and technical communities to source passive engineering candidates. Develop a basic understanding of our tech stack to better qualify resumes and assess potential.

Who You Are

  • Currently pursuing a degree in Human Resources, Marketing, Business, Psychology, Communications, or something related and graduating no earlier than May 2027.

Why Eulerity?

AI and ML at Flagship Pioneering:
Flagship Pioneering is a scientific innovation engine that invents and builds companies that change the world. We bring entrepreneurial scientists together with experienced company builders and assemble the capital to allow them to take courageous leaps in human health, sustainability, technology and beyond. Artificial intelligence is core to how Flagship conceives and builds companies. We call our approach polyintelligence: human creativity and nature’s intelligence integrating and coexisting with artificial intelligence. This model runs across our ecosystem, where teams pair advances in AI and machine learning with foundational science to move from idea to concept faster and build AI-native companies that were previously out of reach.

Who we are looking for:
Computational scientists and engineers with broad interests and experience applying deep technical experience to out of distribution scientific questions. Standalone implementation isn’t the goal, it is creatively spotting opportunities where extension, modification and combination of bleeding edge computational and technical approaches can unlock new capabilities to solve consequential problems. Strong candidates will combine software engineering fundamentals with a readiness to embrace agentic development tools/practices and have experience implementing machine learning models and workflows across multiple model classes or scientific domains.

The Experience:
You will collaborate with Flagship Origination Teams and fellow ML scientists/engineers to explore what is made possible by big leaps beyond the current capabilities of AI. You will begin by asking ‘What if’ across a variety of ideas and building a ‘future backwards’ case for what needs to be true for them to become a reality. You will explore the tradeoffs across multiple options, including what and how much data is needed and where it might come from. You will work towards implementation and evaluation plans that enable us to address the real uncertainties, not just what is easy to measure.
With a project defined, you will begin to implement, evaluate and iterate. You will leverage Flagship's scalable GPU compute resources, data from our ecosystem, and the extensive expertise available across our teams.  You will implement the benchmarking capabilities needed to measure what matters and evaluate your designs. We will learn along the way and be ready to pivot on methods. Final work products are never just a model or a paper, they are wholistic answers to the future backwards questions we ask ourselves when originating the next big leap company.

The pay range for this role is $7,000 - $9,000 per month. This role is a short-term engagement that is not eligible for health and welfare benefits. Compensation and benefits information is based on Flagship Pioneering's good faith estimate as of the date of publication and may be modified in the future.

To exercise your rights or for questions, contact privacy@flagshippioneering.com.

Location: Atlanta, Georgia (Buckhead)

Duration: May 17, 2027 – July 30, 2027

Department: Hive Financial Assets (HFA)

About Us

Hive Financial Systems is a fintech company expanding financial inclusion through AI-driven lending technology. Our multi-portfolio loan management platform powers multiple lending partners serving tens of thousands of active consumers. Hive Financial Assets (HFA) is the company's private credit and investor relations arm, connecting investors to the lending portfolios that make responsible lending possible for underserved markets.

Role Overview

We're looking for a curious, detail-oriented intern to join the HFA team for the summer and provide analytics support across investor relations and capital raising. You'll work with real investor data, including CRM activity, capital raised and rolled, and investor balances, to understand how investors engage with us and help the team act on it. You'll work directly with HFA leadership, partner with Finance, Operations, and Engineering, and finish the summer with projects you can point to.

What You'll Do

  • Build investor interaction models that show how and when investors engage, using CRM activity, email, and meeting data.
  • Help design and test re-engagement ideas, and measure what works from the investor's point of view.
  • Analyze capital flows, including capital raised, rolled, and redeemed, and support forecasting of new capital.
  • Build and maintain dashboards tracking AUM, capital raised YTD, and investor engagement.
  • Help determine each investor's preferred communication method and support next-best-action recommendations for the team.
  • Provide general analytics support for investor updates, pitch materials, and leadership reporting, including checking figures for accuracy.
  • Keep investor data accurate by reconciling CRM records against internal investment schedules and flagging anomalies.

Tools You'll Use

SQL, Hex, Python, Microsoft Excel, our investor CRM, Microsoft Teams and SharePoint, and AI assistants for analysis and documentation.

Qualifications

  • Junior, senior, or master's student in Finance, Data Analytics, Statistics, Economics, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • Working knowledge of SQL (SELECT, JOIN, WHERE, GROUP BY) and strong Excel skills.
  • Some exposure to Python or R for data analysis.
  • Excellent attention to detail, especially with financial data.
  • Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain numbers to non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with a BI tool (Hex, Power BI, Tableau, or similar).

  • Basic statistics or forecasting, such as regression, time series, or A/B testing.

  • Hands-on experience with investor analytics and capital raising at a private credit firm.

  • Mentorship from HFA leadership.

  • Regular feedback and professional development support.
  • Networking with peers and leaders across the company.

description:
Company Overview

IDMe is the next-generation digital identity wallet that simplifies how individuals securely prove their identity online. Consumers can verify their identity with IDMe once and seamlessly login across websites without having to create a new login and verify their identity again. Over 175 million users experience streamlined login and identity verification with IDMe at 22 federal agencies, 50 state government agencies, and more than 100 healthcare organizations. Over 600 consumer brands use IDMe to verify communities and user segments to honor service and build more authentic relationships. IDMe’s technology meets the federal standards for consumer authentication set by the Commerce Department and is approved as a NIST 800-63-3 IAL2 / AAL2 credential service provider by the Kantara Initiative. IDMe is committed to “No Identity Left Behind” to enable all people to have a secure digital identity. To learn more, visit https://network.id.me/.

IDMe is a full-time, in-office culture. Unless a specific job description explicitly states otherwise, all roles are on-site five days per week at one of our offices in McLean, VA; Mountain View, CA; New York City, NY; or Tampa, FL. Certain roles — such as field-based sales or other remote-by-design positions — may have different work arrangements as noted in their individual postings.

At IDMe, we embrace the thoughtful use of AI tools in our daily work and there are even occasions where we leverage AI in our hiring process. However, during the interview process, we want to understand your individual skills and experiences. Therefore, we have guidelines on how AI can be appropriately used during your application and interviews which can be found here.

About the role 

IDMe is hiring a Product Security Engineering Intern for Summer 2027. You will join the Product Security team, which keeps the platform that verifies identities for over 156 million people across 21 federal agencies, 50 state agencies, and more than 600 businesses secure by design. 

This is a hands-on engineering internship, not a shadowing program. You will own a scoped project from start to finish, ship real improvements to how we build and run software, and present your results to security and engineering leadership at the end of the summer. 

Location: Mountain View, California 

What you'll do 

  • Partner with engineering teams on threat models and security design reviews for new features and services. 
  • Triage findings from static analysis (SAST), dependency scanning (SCA), secrets detection, and container scanning, and help engineers fix them. 
  • Build or improve automation that brings security checks into CI/CD pipelines and developer workflows. 
  • Help assess and improve the security posture of our cloud environments, including cloud security posture management (CSPM) and container runtime tooling. 
  • Perform focused code reviews and security testing against industry-standard and internal security frameworks and requirements. 
  • Write clear documentation, secure coding guidance, and runbooks that engineers will actually use. 
  • Deliver an intern capstone project and present it to the team at the end of the summer. 
  • Your capstone will go deep on one or two of the areas above rather than touching all of them; your mentor will help you pick the one with the clearest scope and the most direct line to a shipped improvement. 

What we're looking for

  • Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Computer Engineering, or a related field. 
  • Working knowledge of common web application vulnerabilities (injection, XSS, broken authentication, access control flaws) and how to prevent them. 
  • Familiarity with Git, the Linux command line, and basic networking concepts (HTTP, TLS, DNS). 
  • Curiosity, a builder's mindset, and the ability to explain technical risk clearly to engineers who are not security specialists. 
  • Must be authorized to work in the United States. 
  • Must be able to pass a standard background check, consistent with our work for government agencies and regulated industries. 

Nice to have 

  • Experience with a major cloud provider, containers, or container orchestration. * Hands-on experience with application security testing and scanning tools. 
  • CTF participation, bug bounty findings, a security club, open-source contributions, or a home lab you can talk about. 
  • Coursework or projects in applied cryptography, identity and access management, or authentication protocols (OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SAML).

description:
Are you a curious, analytical student who wants to see how strategy decisions get made at a fast-growing payments company? As a Business Strategy Intern on NMI’s Revenue Acceleration team, you’ll own strategic projects for our leadership team, covering pricing, monetization and competitive strategy across the payments and fintech landscape.

This is a US remote internship for Summer 2027, running 11–13 weeks. You’ll use AI throughout your work, partner with stakeholders across the business, and end the summer by presenting your findings and recommendations to our executive team. Working hours are 8am–5pm, Monday through Friday in your local time zone. We prefer candidates in the Eastern or Central time zones, but welcome applicants from anywhere in the US.

About NMI

NMI, a global leader in payment technologies, allows software and sales professionals to deliver payment innovations to their clients without having to build payment expertise in house. NMI enables our partners with choice, and challenges the one-size-fits-all approach to payments. You’ve probably used NMI in the last 24 hours without even realizing it. We’re the platform that powers success for innovative tech created by SMBs, entrepreneurs and fintech startups. We’re creative problem solvers who help visionaries smash through boundaries and think beyond what’s possible so they can think about what’s next. But we’re not just built for the tech savvy. We democratize the latest payments technology so that everyone can realize the benefits of easy payments across the full spectrum of commerce. Our mission is to use our expertise to enable more payments, in more ways and more places. We provide ISOs, Fintech Innovators and Technologists the freedom to focus on what they do best, liberating them from restricted payment solutions and giving them access to the latest payment technology now and in the future.

How We Work - Our Core Values

  • Be a Good Person, It’s Simple. We treat everyone fairly and with respect. We lead with kindness, humility and integrity. We take the time to understand each other and our customers. And we serve with care, because customers are never a transaction, and always our focus
  • Align, Trust & Go. We debate openly, listen carefully and challenge thoughtfully. Once we decide, we move forward together - holding ourselves accountable to our commitments, and focusing on what matters most to our customers. That alignment creates momentum.
  • Raise the Bar. Good enough isn’t enough. We stay curious, measure everything, stay honest about progress and keep pushing ourselves to think creatively. We drive change, again and again. And leave things better than we found them. When we raise the bar, our customers feel it too.

What will I be doing?

  • Analyze pricing and monetization approaches across the payments and fintech industry, and turn them into practical recommendations for NMI.
  • Research the competitive landscape, including competitors’ product strategy, packaging, go-to-market approach and AI capabilities.
  • Use AI throughout your work, including agentic AI, generative AI and other AI tools, to research, analyze data, build models and create deliverables faster and at a higher level.
  • Build business cases and financial models that help leadership evaluate strategic opportunities.
  • Create reusable assets, such as competitive trackers and comparison frameworks, that the team can maintain and update over time.
  • Turn your analysis into executive-ready briefs and presentations, and refine them with input from cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Present your findings and recommendations to NMI’s executive team at the end of the summer.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Currently pursuing an undergraduate or graduate degree in Business, Finance, Economics or a related field, and returning to school after the internship (not graduating in 2027).
  • Prior professional experience, such as a previous internship or part-time role.
  • Strong financial modeling and Excel skills, with the ability to build models that support business decisions.
  • Clear, structured written and verbal communication, and confidence presenting to senior audiences.
  • A genuine interest in payments, pricing and strategy. Payments experience isn’t required.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in consulting, banking, corporate strategy or fintech.
  • Experience with business intelligence tools, especially Tableau.

Do you feel like you have a slightly out of the ordinary career path or history? We are open to all walks of life and very willing to hear your story. Please don’t feel like this should be a barrier to securing a great career at NMI! We appreciate success can come in all shapes and sizes. Fill in the ‘Additional Info’ box on our application to tell us more about your path.

As well as being a part of something exciting everyday, you will also receive the following benefits:

  • A remote first culture!
  • Direct exposure to senior leadership and a dedicated mentor
  • Real projects that make an impact, ending in a final presentation to the executive team

Please note: This is a summer internship and does not convert into a full-time role at the end of the program. Interns are welcome to apply to open positions across NMI through the standard hiring process after finishing their degrees.

About Pinterest:

Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.

Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.

At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.

Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here.

As a Strategy & Operations Intern on Pinterest’s Global Content Organization (GCO), you’ll support business planning, performance analysis, and scoped operational projects. You’ll turn data into clear insights, track progress against team goals, and identify practical ways to improve how work gets done.

What you’ll do:

  • Analyze business and operational metrics to identify trends, summarize findings, and explain performance against defined goals.
  • Build or improve a recurring report or dashboard for a focused set of metrics; document metric definitions and refresh steps.
  • Support team planning and goal-setting by organizing inputs, maintaining a milestone tracker, and surfacing open questions and dependencies.
  • Coordinate a scoped team project by tracking milestones, documenting decisions, and preparing concise status updates.
  • Review a routine workflow and recommend a practical improvement, including the expected benefit and suggested next step.
  • Use Pinterest-approved AI and internal tools, where appropriate, to support research, analysis, and workflow improvement; validate outputs, use sound judgment, and follow responsible-use guidance.


What we are looking for:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Finance, Statistics, Business Analytics, Data Analytics, a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Experience analyzing data to identify trends, answer defined business questions, and communicate clear takeaways.
  • Experience using spreadsheets, reports, dashboards, or similar tools to organize, analyze, and present information.
  • Ability to bring structure to ambiguous questions, identify relevant inputs, and develop practical next steps with manager guidance.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail when tracking milestones, documenting decisions, and maintaining project materials.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to share concise updates and collaborate effectively with relevant stakeholders.
  • Ability to use AI to improve the speed and quality of relevant research, analysis, or workflow outputs while validating accuracy and quality.
  • High integrity and ownership when using AI and internal tools, including protecting sensitive data, following responsible-use guidance, and remaining accountable for final deliverables.

In-Office Requirement:

  • We let the type of work you do guide the collaboration style. That means we're not always working in an office, but we continue to gather for key moments of collaboration and connection.
  • For this role, all interns will work in a hybrid model (commutable distance to one of our offices, with in-person collaboration approximately 1–3 times per week). Specific location(s) will be confirmed during the interview and offer process.

Relocation Statement:

  • This position may be eligible for relocation assistance. Visit our PinFlex page to learn more about our working model.
  • Information regarding the culture at Pinterest and benefits available for this position can be found here.

We offer 2 internship start dates:

  • May 17, 2027 - August 6, 2027
  • June 14, 2027 - September 3, 2027 

US based applicants only

The minimum and maximum salary for this position is $7,000 - $9,500 monthly.

We offer you a clear path based on your abilities, willingness to work hard, and performance. Join us if you're looking for a career at the forefront of investing.

This 12-week summer internship will provide you with valuable experience at a complex global firm. During your time with us, you will gain exposure to:

  • Conducting research on compliance approved AI applications regionally, assessing their viability as well as identifying key advantages and potential drawbacks
  • Automating processes using internal tools, and integrating research outputs generated by various teams on a regular basis
  • Identifying opportunities for streamlining processes and enhancing team workflows

You’ll work alongside a talented team with diverse skills, backgrounds, and perspectives. Our sector data analysts, data scientists, data managers, and engineers work together to build compliant research products that are incorporated into the research process of our investment professionals.   • Supporting the evaluation and testing of compliance approved AI-enabled research tools and workflows, helping assess whether outputs are accurate, relevant, explainable, and useful for investment research

WHAT EXCITES YOU

We operate an advanced, end-to-end manufacturing platform that partners with industrial companies and innovators to take products from first concept to full-scale production in critical verticals including aerospace and defense, electrification, medical, energy and environment, and robotics and automation.

The way we operate is as important as the work we do. It's guided by The Re:Build Way, 16 principles that shape how we collaborate with each other, partner with our customers and vendors, and contribute to the communities where we operate. The Re:Build Way principles

Who is Re:Build Fikst?

Re:Build Fikst, a Re:Build Manufacturing company, is a dynamic product development and engineering consulting firm located in Wilmington, MA. We work with pioneering clients to develop their technology, design their products, and bring those products to production. Re:Build Fikst's areas of expertise include biomedical instruments and consumables, microfluidics, specialty plastic design, optics, industrial automation, robotics, and design for manufacturing. We have extensive in-house laboratory and rapid prototyping capability including CNCs, 3D printers, waterjet and laser cutters, which help facilitate our ability to prototype and innovate fast. As part of Re:Build Manufacturing, we are able to collaborate with other member sites and leverage a greater network of capabilities including composites, industrial design, structural analysis, and embedded systems design.

Who we are looking for

  • Creative problem solvers who can connect scientific theory with engineering design to create novel products.

We’re hiring mechanical engineering interns excited about product development. In this role engineers will gain experience with mechanical design and consulting. They will gain experience developing designs, building and testing prototypes, and using the knowledge gained through testing to refine and improve on previous designs. Fikst’s projects are all hands-on and our prototyping shop includes CNC mills, lathe, 3D-printers, laser cutters and a variety of other scientific and engineering equipment. In addition to hourly rate, this role may be eligible for annual incentive compensation and/or long-term incentives, subject to Company plans. The BIG payoff

We are a company that is going to make a difference in the industries and the communities in which we choose to operate.

Every employee of Re:Build will share ownership in the company and share in the financial rewards of the success we achieve together, at all company levels!

RoboForce is an AI robotics company developing Physical AI–powered Robo-Labor for dull, dirty, and dangerous work. The company’s robots are engineered for demanding industrial environments, with a focus on real-world deployment and scalability.

We are seeking a Machine Learning Engineer Intern to join us in developing advanced AI capabilities for robotics. The internship starts from November 2026 for 3-6 months. As part of our team, you will help build the foundational AI ecosystem, spanning data collection, labeling, training, evaluation, and deployment.

You will collaborate closely with a team of world-class AI engineers and gain hands-on experience solving real-world challenges at the intersection of artificial intelligence and robotics.

  • Train and improve robot foundation models, including vision-language-action (VLA) models and world-action models, for precise, contact-rich manipulation in industrial settings.

  • Explore new modalities and methods, including tactile and force-torque sensing, reinforcement learning, and simulation, to advance model capabilities.

  • Build data pipelines for robot learning, including data collection, curation, labeling, and dataset quality assurance.

  • Design and run evaluations in simulation and on real robots to measure and improve model performance.

  • Deploy models on robots and optimize them for real-time onboard inference.

  • Work closely with robotics, hardware, and product teams to bring models from research to production.

  • Currently pursuing an advanced degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Machine Learning, or a related field, with a graduation date in 2026 or 2027.

  • Proficiency in multimodal models, modern machine learning architectures (e.g., transformers and diffusion models), and reinforcement learning.

  • Proficiency in deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch, JAX, or TensorFlow.

  • Requires 5 days/week in-office collaboration with the teams.

Bonus Qualifications

  • Exposure to robot learning using tactile and/or vision-based sensors.

  • Expertise in object pose estimation, bimanual manipulation, and synthetic data.

  • 3–6 months, full-time

The hardware footprint is big – we build ultra-low power sensors, ruggedized asset trackers, vehicle ADAS systems with AI/ML, telematics systems, and rackmount video inspection with AI/Ml, with more to come in the future.
